body:
The published byte-to-word experiment and first graphics example now have fresh execution evidence on the named AmiBlitz/A1200 setup. Guest output confirms -106 for the byte and 150 for the word; the graphics program displayed both shapes and returned to Workbench on a click. All three compiled with zero errors.

Both live setup-to-first-program routes and representative changed opening pages were reviewed at 390×844 and 1440×900. The retained verifier checks numeric invariants, compiler completion and unchanged probe identities; its wrong-value control is rejected. No public lessons or samples changed, so no site rebuild is required.

The report records the temporary computer-use failure and recovery, failed HTTP fallback, archive extraction limit and actual browser coverage. This is CLI execution plus native observation, not a repeated PED cycle, learner trial, overflow-check-on diagnostic or benchmark.

Closes code198x/website#766.
Closes code198x/website#767.
Part of stevehill1981/198x#116, which remains open.
title: Verify the Amiga opening numeric and graphics examples
